title: RSI-Opt: Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents For Model Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.32026v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conventional neural-network training typically follows a predefined optimization recipe, motivating a LLM agent that monitors training dynamics and adjusts optimizer settings as training progresses, but a fixed agent policy does not accumulate experience across runs. We introduce RSI-Opt, a plug-and-play Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents which evolves the knowledge that guides this process: a prompt, a playbook of procedures, a library of tested optimizer code, and a decision cadence. A meta-agent rewrites this policy using evidence from earlier runs, and an archive retains evaluated policies for further evolution. Across 5 generations on three training tasks, the meta-agents develop reusable procedures and code and conduct their own CPU proxy experiments. translated_title: RSI-Opt：用于模型训练的递归自我改进优化器智能体
translated_abstract: 传统的神经网络训练通常遵循预定义的优化方案，这促使人们开发能够监控训练动态并随训练进程调整优化器设置的大语言模型（LLM）智能体，但固定的智能体策略无法在多次运行之间积累经验。我们提出了RSI-Opt，一个即插即用的递归自我改进优化器智能体，它能够演化指导这一过程的知识：包括提示词、程序操作手册、经过测试的优化器代码库以及决策节奏。一个元智能体利用先前运行的证据重写该策略，并通过存档保留已评估的策略以供进一步演化。在三个训练任务上经过5代演化，元智能体开发出了可复用的程序和代码，并开展了自己的CPU代理实验。RSI-Opt显著提升了优化器智能体的性能，在演化套件上具有代表性的原始空间汇总z分数从+10.48提升至+14.33。
tldr: RSI-Opt提出了一个即插即用的递归自我改进优化器智能体框架，元智能体利用历史运行证据持续演化指导策略（提示词、操作手册、代码库和决策节奏），显著提升了LLM智能体自动调节模型训练优化器的性能。
en_tdlr: RSI-Opt is a plug-and-play recursive self-improvement framework for optimizer agents, where a meta-agent evolves the guiding policy (prompt, playbook, code library, and decision cadence) using evidence from prior runs, substantially improving LLM-agent-based neural network training performance.
